---
title: "p1 Import"
---

Downloads StatsBomb's free data (about an hour). Always downloads everything when run.

Makes:

- data/Comp_Match_Data.RData: competitions and matches (Comp and Matches)
- data/raw_events/: one file of raw events per competition season, which p2 reads

Player names are removed here, before anything is saved.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(StatsBombR)
library(here)
here::i_am("_pipeline/p1_import.qmd")

dir.create(here("data", "raw_events"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here("outputs"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Competitions and matches

```{r}
Comp <- FreeCompetitions()

Matches <- FreeMatches(Comp) |>
  left_join(Comp |> select(competition_id, season_id, competition_name, season_name,
                           competition_gender, competition_youth),
            by = c("competition.competition_id" = "competition_id",
                   "season.season_id" = "season_id"))

save(Comp, Matches, file = here("data", "Comp_Match_Data.RData"))
cat(nrow(Matches), "matches across", n_distinct(Matches$competition_name), "competitions\n")
```

# Raw events, one file per competition season

File names like "1. Bundesliga" 2015/2016 = 1_Bundesliga_2015_2016.rds.

```{r}
comp_seasons <- Matches |>
  mutate(file = paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", competition_name), "_",
                       gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", season_name), ".rds")) |>
  group_split(file)

for (season_matches in comp_seasons) {
  out <- here("data", "raw_events", season_matches$file[1])

  events <- free_allevents(MatchesDF = season_matches, Parallel = TRUE) |>
    select(-any_of(c("player.name", "pass.recipient.name", "substitution.replacement.name"))) # no names

  saveRDS(events, out)
  cat(basename(out), "-", nrow(events), "events\n")
  rm(events)
  gc()
}

cat(length(list.files(here("data", "raw_events"))), "of", length(comp_seasons), "competition seasons downloaded\n")
```
